timing_scope.construction: construct entire automaton from pregenerated input; includes allocations
timing_scope.first_count: count an existing nonempty pattern after construction, including lazy occurrence rebuild
timing_scope.lcs: longest_common_substring calls plus result checksum, grouped by query kind
timing_scope.count_reuse: count calls plus result checksum after first count has rebuilt occurrence counts
timing_scope.excluded: input and query generation, parsing, output, and automaton destruction
timing_scope.rss: Linux getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) max RSS KiB, including input and query arrays; -1 means unavailable
timing_scope.scenarios: unary; period-5; random sigma=4; random sigma=96; int random sigma=65536
timing_scope.queries: short_match and long_match are source substrings; short_miss uses absent symbols; long_mismatch changes every seventh symbol to an absent symbol
timing_scope.query_order: phase order rotates per repetition, identically for both versions
